title: Сортировка 3-х Миров (Will vs Going to vs PresCont)
description: Распредели предложения по группам: Will, Be going to, Present Continuous.

items.verb: I think I will buy this book.
I am going to buy this book next week.
I am buying this book tomorrow. I ordered it.
Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
— The phone is ringing. — I will answer it!
We are flying to Paris tomorrow at 5 PM.
